16th October 2026


*Bramford to Twinstead*


We recently published the October edition of our e-newsletter, which we use to share updates from the construction of the Bramford to Twinstead Reinforcement.


In the latest update, you can learn more about:


- current and upcoming construction activity, including vegetation management and the start of underground cable works in the Dedham Vale National Landscape
- new animations showing how we are building the project
- the first grants awarded by our Community Fund
- how our team raised money for charity by climbing a pylon.


**You can read the e-newsletter by clicking**[here](https://nationalgrid.tractivity.io/Email/ViewInBrowser/bf3ea43b-a9c3-4958-8f34-248acdf3c19b) **. To receive the latest updates direct your inbox, you can sign up to receive our email updates by clicking**[here](https://nationalgrid.tractivity.io/ExternalFormViewer/Form.aspx?ExternalFormID=40) **.**
